region_scene_page.compact: John Williams, Hans Zimmer, Ennio Morricone, Howard Shore, Danny Elfman, Vangelis, and others show how score becomes standalone listening.

region_scene_page.deep: John Williams, Hans Zimmer, Ennio Morricone, Howard Shore, Danny Elfman, Vangelis, and others show how score becomes standalone listening.
